title: Python Foundations: Build a Research Tool
description: Learn Python by building and testing a small command-line project from first principles.
prerequisites: None. Every lesson runs inside AIDE.
assessment: Complete the capstone, pass all checks, and explain the design decisions.

lessons.title: Values and Variables
lessons.objective: Store and inspect a value safely.

lessons.title: Decisions and Loops
lessons.objective: Use conditions and loops to classify inputs.
lessons.check: python -c "assert [x for x in range(4) if x % 2 == 0] == [0,2]"

lessons.title: Functions and Boundaries
lessons.objective: Turn repeated work into a reusable function.
lessons.check: python -c "def normalize(value): return value.strip().lower(); assert normalize(' Claim ') == 'claim'"

lessons.title: Collections and Records
lessons.objective: Represent multiple records and find one by title.

lessons.title: Modules and Packages
lessons.objective: Split a growing program into importable modules.

lessons.title: Errors and Recovery
lessons.objective: Handle invalid input without hiding the failure.
lessons.check:
python -c "try: int('x'); raise AssertionError
except ValueError: pass"

lessons.title: Files and Structured Data
lessons.objective: Read and write a small JSON record safely.

lessons.title: Tests as Proof
lessons.objective: Write a test that catches a broken transformation.

lessons.title: Debugging a Failure
lessons.objective: Use a traceback and a failing test to locate a defect.

lessons.title: Package a Command-Line Tool
lessons.objective: Make a small tool installable and documented.

lessons.title: Capstone: Evidence Organizer
lessons.objective: Build, test, document, and explain the complete project.
